entities.summary: Sukkhasoem was a monarchs & rulers in Luang Prabang (1797, Luang Prabang – 1850-09-23), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
